aToB.memory: Living in Mooncrest Hall and sharing Herbology Class with Kaede feels a bit like living next to a crisp morning breeze. While Kaede's blunt dawn energy occasionally startles Noelle out of a warm half-nap, Noelle enjoys watching Kaede practice wind-step blade forms in the courtyard mist below Skyglass Observatory—finding a quiet, meditative cadence beneath all that athletic speed.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Noelle wants to murmur a sleepy compliment on Kaede's dawn wind-blade forms earlier and casually warn her not to bet on clear skies during afternoon practice.

bToA.memory: Kaede knows Mooncrest hallmate Noelle as the pale, silver-haired night owl who shows up to Herbology Class looking half-dreaming yet casually predicts sudden squalls before a single cloud forms. Kaede once caught Noelle by the elbow just before she walked straight into a bamboo garden lantern at dawn and has quietly looked out for her around stairs ever since.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Kaede wants to ask directly whether Noelle actually slept more than three hours last night and drag her toward warm breakfast before Herbology Class starts.
